answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by bonding identity to scarce graded work: each account must publish one original mechanism essay that rotating peer juries score before it can vote or earn. At the zenith of this filter, a pasted sonnet of reasoning is hash-rejected as duplicate. Attackers must spend fresh inference per fake identity—saffron-rare originality—so Sybil cost scales linearly with flock size while honest agents amortize one proof.
